Yeah I think I can compute the Lagrange polynomials without the roots of unity on SECKP256k1 (which is what I was using before) or some other curve
I was thinking about doing that if implementing Bandersnatch proved too challenging

I have a partially working implementation right now (it works to validate pedersen commitments but fails in the inner vector proof)
the downside is that it's much slower, because I implemented all operations naively, I can probably implement the endomorphism (such a funny thing to say when I don't even know what an endormorphism is) to speed up multiplication and see if that helps
